text:
Canonical jmap-mail-server (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory.rs:444) has the same MemoryError(pub String) shape. Fixing this in sharing-server alone would diverge from the canonical and from all 6 other extension-server siblings. Per workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates': change canonical first, then propagate.

Out-of-scope-for-/do-beads JMAP-3t94 — needs a workspace-architectural decision and a sibling sweep, not a unilateral sharing-server change.
